comparability: Retain three qualified, substantively distinct responses after challenging each from actual content, contribution and weight. Each contains all six available History courses45EC: modern history, American gender history with interviews, empire, warfare, Native American social/cultural history, and a final archival/primary-source research paper on Walcheren1809. This is sustained historical object/method/progression, not merely a coherent unrelated programme or a generic interest in society. Cultural heritage/public memory adds art/archaeology, historiography, life-writing and historical media; political conflict/social inclusion adds institutions, rights, international relations and sociological enquiry; political economy adds five economic theory/inference courses plus social theory to study mechanisms of historical change. These companions have distinct taught objects/methods and change substantial course weight, not just labels. Their relevance does not make economics, statistics, sociology or contemporary politics into economic/migration history. No UCR composition reproduces VU broader medieval/earlymodern and Netherlands sequences, Holocaust-centred genocide historiography, digital-history training, LowCountriesdevotion research, specialist photography seminar or individualHistorythesis.
